title: Shared-repo dual edit then integrate with repair
objective: Worker A: write edits/a.md with one short sentence about alpha. Worker B: write edits/b.md with one short sentence about beta. Integrate: merge both into catalog.md and publish it. Verify: confirm catalog.md exists and publish a one-line verify.md. Keep tool use minimal.

nodes.objective: This unit only: read attachments/a.txt, write edits/a.md with one short sentence about alpha, then publish edits/a.md. Do not perform later units' work.
This unit only: read attachments/b.txt, write edits/b.md with one short sentence about beta, then publish edits/b.md. Do not perform later units' work.

This unit only: merge the deliverables staged by the prerequisite units (<work_unit_id>.md at the workspace top level) into catalog.md listing both alpha and beta, then publish catalog.md. Do not perform the verify step.

This unit only: the integrated deliverable is staged at delivered/<integrate_work_unit_id>.md. Read that exact file, write verify.md with an explicit PASS or FAIL verdict (FAIL if it is absent or does not mention both alpha and beta), then publish verify.md. Do not rewrite another unit's deliverable.
